title: Engineer with a spreadsheet of lenders
scenario: Analytical engineer is comparing lenders for a purchase in the spring and wants a breakdown of costs. He is polite but makes clear he is only gathering data.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Viktor? This is Celeste with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes, hello. Thanks for calling.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course. I see you're looking at a purchase?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Eventually. I'm building a spreadsheet of lenders right now, comparing fees and terms. Just collecting data, nothing serious yet.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Love that you're doing your homework. What's your timeline looking like?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Probably April or May. Our lease ends in June.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. And what price range?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Five hundred to five-fifty.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got it. Do you know your credit score?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Seven-ninety-something, last I checked.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Excellent. Are you planning on twenty percent down?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes. So what are your lender fees, specifically? Origination, underwriting, that kind of thing?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Those depend on the loan program and whether you choose to buy down a rate, so the cleanest comparison is an official Loan Estimate. I can explain each line once you have it.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Every lender says that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It's because the estimate is the only apples-to-apples document. You can line them up line by line in your spreadsheet.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. That's actually a good point.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Would you like me to send you a short guide on how to read a Loan Estimate?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure. But again, I'm just gathering info. I won't decide anything until spring.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understood. Mind if I check back in February?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: February's okay.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. I'll send that guide today. Thanks, Viktor.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thank you.
